text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. How long, O Jehovah?{H3068} wilt thou forget{H7911} me for ever?{H5331} How long wilt thou hide{H5641} thy face{H6440} from me?
How long shall I take{H7896} counsel{H6098} in my soul,{H5315} Having sorrow{H3015} in my heart{H3824} all the day?{H3119} How long shall mine enemy{H341} be exalted{H7311} over me?
Consider{H5027} [and] answer{H6030} me, O Jehovah{H3068} my God:{H430} Lighten{H215} mine eyes,{H5869} lest I sleep{H3462} the [sleep of] death;{H4194}
Lest mine enemy{H341} say,{H559} I have prevailed{H3201} against him; [Lest] mine adversaries{H6862} rejoice{H1523} when I am moved.{H4131}
But I have trusted{H982} in thy lovingkindness;{H2617} My heart{H3820} shall rejoice{H1523} in thy salvation.{H3444}
I will sing{H7891} unto Jehovah,{H3068} Because he hath dealt bountifully{H1580} with me.
